loc.village_square.name: Village Square
loc.village_square.description: A sunny cobblestone square with paths leading in every direction.

loc.bakery.name: Warm Bakery
loc.bakery.description: Fresh bread cools beside a brick oven.

loc.old_bridge.name: Old Bridge
loc.old_bridge.description: A weathered bridge crosses a narrow, fast stream.

loc.forest_path.name: Forest Path
loc.forest_path.description: Tall pines make a green tunnel around the path.

loc.ancient_ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
loc.ancient_ruins.description: Broken stone walls surround a quiet courtyard.

loc.guard_post.name: Guard Post
loc.guard_post.description: A small watchtower overlooks the western road.

loc.herb_garden.name: Herb Garden
loc.herb_garden.description: Neat beds of fragrant plants grow behind a low fence.

loc.lakeside.name: Lakeside
loc.lakeside.description: Reeds sway beside clear blue water.

loc.cave.name: Goblin Cave
loc.cave.description: A cold side passage ends in a smoky underground den.

item.bread.name: Fresh Bread
item.bread.description: A warm loaf from the village bakery.

item.healing_herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.healing_herbs.description: Green leaves used by the village healer.

item.lantern.name: Brass Lantern
item.lantern.description: A sturdy lantern with enough oil for one journey.

item.old_map.name: Old Map
item.old_map.description: A faded map showing paths around the village.

item.healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
item.healing_potion.description: A red potion awarded for helping the healer.

item.guard_medal.name: Guard Medal
item.guard_medal.description: A medal awarded for making the roads safer.

npc.healer.name: Village Healer
npc.healer.description: A patient herbalist carrying a worn notebook.
dialogue: The garden has what I need, if you can spare the time.

npc.guard.name: Village Guard
npc.guard.description: A watchful guard in a dented helmet.
dialogue: A goblin has occupied the cave beyond the forest.

npc.baker.name: Baker
npc.baker.description: A cheerful baker dusted with flour.
dialogue: Welcome! The first loaf of the day is always the best.

npc.goblin.name: Cave Goblin
npc.goblin.description: A small but dangerous goblin blocks the cave.
dialogue: The goblin growls and reaches for its club.

quest.fetch_herbs.description: Bring the Healing Herbs to the Village Healer.

quest.defeat_goblin.description: Defeat the Cave Goblin and report to the Village Guard.
